assumptions.topic: ambiguous simultaneous long and short entries
assumptions.choice: Enter long only when the shared turbulence-crossing condition occurs.
assumptions.reason: The specification gives identical entry conditions for long and short positions without a direction-selection rule; a single-asset Backtrader position is netted, so simultaneous long and short positions cannot be represented independently.

assumptions.choice: Evaluate signals only on the final daily bar of each calendar month, using that bar's close as the month-end closing price.
assumptions.reason: The supplied feed is daily while the specification requires monthly closing prices.

assumptions.choice: Use the sample variance of the prior 24 monthly returns as the one-asset covariance matrix.
assumptions.reason: With one asset, the covariance matrix reduces to a scalar variance; the specification does not state a population-versus-sample convention.

assumptions.choice: Use the 95th percentile of the preceding 24 completed turbulence values.
assumptions.reason: The specification calls for the 95th percentile of historical FT values calculated during the lookback period.

assumptions.choice: Submit a Backtrader stop order after a completed long entry at 2% below the executed entry price.
assumptions.reason: The supplied data and chosen resolution support a literal long stop-loss implementation; short entry is unresolved by the stated identical signal.
